summary: Louisiana has official Secretary of State 2024 parish presidential totals derived from precinct CSV rows, official precinct and vote-mode President-versus-U.S.-House review rows, official Secretary of State parish post-election turnout/qualified-voter statistics, official 2016 and 2020 parish presidential historical baselines, Census parish geometry, and county/parish equipment context. Precinct boundary geometry, the official 2012 historical baseline, and normalized audit/CVR/incident/correction/recount/litigation records remain uncollected.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Louisiana Secretary of State official 2024 general election precinct CSV results
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: louisianaSosPrecinctCsvDirectory via etl/state-configs/la.json certifiedResults and reviewCharts
caveats: President rows are aggregated to parish result rows for the map while local review rows retain parish, ward, precinct, and vote-mode keys where available.
U.S. House is district-based and candidate-specific, so Louisiana review charts are advisory source-review context rather than a statewide same-office comparison.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Louisiana Secretary of State 2024 post-election statistics workbooks
caveats: The graphical page Statistics tab describes these as qualified voter statistics, not all registered voters.
Qualified voters are registrants deemed eligible for the election as of the close of registration records thirty days before election day.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Louisiana Secretary of State parish post-election turnout statistics
caveats: The Voted field is election-level turnout from post-election statistics, not presidential contest votes.
The denominator is SOS qualified voters from active and inactive status rows as of the close of registration records thirty days before the election.
The retained EAC benchmark is 424 voters and one registered/qualified voter higher statewide.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: U.S. EAC 2024 EAVS V2 Louisiana jurisdiction turnout benchmark
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: eacTurnoutCsv retained as benchmark in etl/state-configs/la.json sources
caveats: No longer the active Louisiana turnout source after SOS post-election statistics activation.
Retained for source comparison and EAC reconciliation context.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Louisiana Secretary of State 2024 general election human-readable workbook
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: louisianaSosHumanReadableWorkbook retained in etl/state-configs/la.json sources for provenance/manual inspection
caveats: The active native ETL reads the paired official precinct CSV artifacts directly; the workbook is retained for provenance and manual reconciliation.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: U.S. Census TIGERweb Louisiana parish geography
caveats: Parish geometry supports parish map joins only; precinct boundary geometry is not loaded.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Verified Voting Verifier Louisiana 2024 equipment context
caveats: Equipment context is not a vote, turnout, audit, CVR, incident, correction, recount, or litigation source and does not prove every precinct in a parish used one identical configuration.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Louisiana Secretary of State official 2016 and 2020 Presidential Electors ByParish CSVs
caveats: Rows are contextual parish baselines for county-equivalent historical joins, not 2024 certified-result rows.
An official 2012 Louisiana parish presidential baseline remains uncollected.

stateNativeTurnout.caveat: SOS qualified-voter denominator is not all registered voters; it is the election-qualified voter count as of the close of registration records thirty days before election day.

precinctBoundaryGeometry.requestNeed: Official statewide precinct boundary geometry or a precinct-to-parish crosswalk if subparish map overlays are required.

historicalBaselines.requestNeed: Collect and normalize an official Louisiana 2012 presidential result artifact with parish totals, source URL, parser path, and statewide reconciliation totals.

postElectionAudit.requestNeed: Official 2024 Louisiana post-election audit selection and outcome artifacts, if published or obtainable, with parish/reporting-unit grain and discrepancy fields.

cvrAvailability.requestNeed: Official SOS or parish CVR availability records, public-records request responses, or documented nonavailability notes before claiming CVR coverage.

incidentsCorrectionsRecountsLitigation.requestNeed: Official incident, correction, recount, election-contest, or litigation records for the 2024 general election, normalized only after authoritative source collection.

displayApiCaveats.advisoryUse: Louisiana advisory indicators use official precinct and vote-mode President-versus-U.S.-House review rows. U.S. House is district-based, and the review rows are screening/context signals only, not claims of fraud or misconduct.
displayApiCaveats.productionPromotion: Not authorized from worker branch; no native:promote or native:counts run.
displayApiCaveats.turnoutUse: Louisiana turnout uses official SOS parish post-election statistics. Qualified voters are election-eligible registrants as of the close of registration records thirty days before election day; Voted is election-level turnout, not presidential contest votes.

gaps.remainingRisk: Public map joins remain parish geometry only.
Official 2016 and 2020 historical context is loaded; 2012 parish historical context remains unavailable until an official artifact is collected and normalized.
No normalized audit selection/outcome rows are available.
No CVR availability table or CVR dataset is available.
